run_camera_optimization: run the pulsar camera parameter optimization example to generate cam.gif from a reference image
create_scenemodel: create a SceneModel nn.Module with randomized sphere positions, colors, radii, and trainable camera parameters
render_with_pulsar: render a 3D scene using the pulsar Renderer with vertex positions, colors, radii, and camera parameters
optimize_camera_params: optimize camera position, rotation, and sensor parameters using SGD to match a reference rendered image
review_scenemodel_forward: review the SceneModel forward method that passes scene and camera parameters to the pulsar renderer
